name: Lyo.Translation.Google
tagline: Google Cloud Translation v2 implementation of `ITranslationService`. `GoogleTranslationService` extends `TranslationServiceBase` and calls the REST API over HTTP.
description:
Google Cloud Translation v2 implementation of `ITranslationService`. `GoogleTranslationService` extends `TranslationServiceBase` and calls the REST API over HTTP.

**Target frameworks:** `netstandard2.0;net10.0`

examples.title: Register with DI

sections.title: Dependency injection
items: `AddGoogleTranslationService(GoogleTranslationOptions options)` takes a pre-built options instance.

sections.title: `GoogleTranslationOptions`
rows: Google Cloud API key. Required by `TranslateCoreAsync`. The service throws when it is missing.
GCP project id, used with service-account auth.
Optional path to a service-account credential JSON file.
REST endpoint base; trailing slashes are stripped at startup.

sections.title: Behavior notes
rows: POSTs to `{ApiEndpoint}?key={ApiKey}` with `{ q, target, source }` (source omitted when not provided for auto-detect).
Google Translate uses ISO 639-1; the service derives that from `LanguageCodeInfo.Iso6391` (falls back to the first segment of `Bcp47`).
`TranslateCoreAsync` maps the API's `detectedSourceLanguage` through `LanguageCodeInfo.FromISO639_1` when present.

`Dispose` disposes the HTTP client the service created. An externally supplied `HttpClient` is also disposed when passed in, so prefer injecting a long-lived client via DI and letting the consumer manage its lifetime.
